item.title: ‘KPop Demon Hunters’ & ‘Elio’ Top 2026 Annie Awards Nominations
item.description: There is likely a big showdown coming between “KPop Demon Hunters” and “Zootopia 2” at the Oscars in March, but the Netflix and Sony Animation production came out on top in terms of Annie Awards nominations. The 53rd edition of the venerable ASIFA-Hollywood awards saw “KPop” earn 13 nominations, Pixar’s “Elio” take 10, “Zootopia 2” and “Little Amélie or the Character of Rain” land seven each.
